statement: A complete inventory of files does not prove correctness of derived structured records.
actakit_implication: ActaKit fixtures/tests must audit derived claims/identity/relations against artifacts, not only pipeline completion.

statement: Identity errors propagate into downstream records and can make structurally valid data semantically wrong.
actakit_implication: Identity reconciliation requires explicit audit and provenance.

statement: Research transfers need explicit stop conditions so external mechanisms do not become accidental architecture authority.
actakit_implication: Every adopted standard pattern in this Book has a non-transfer boundary.

statement: A research horizon is complete when remaining gaps no longer threaten the pending decision, not when source count reaches a quota.
actakit_implication: Stop this Book at pre-SQL semantics; move unanswered implementation detail into fixtures/SQL study.

statement: A cross-domain mechanism is transferable only when the shared problem, mechanism, bounded transfer and stop condition are explicit.
actakit_implication: Every standards-derived schema pressure must include a do-not-copy boundary and stop condition.

statement: Research quality improves when atomic claims and relationships live in ledgers while Markdown is reserved for synthesis and rationale.
actakit_implication: Keep per-Book claim/source ledgers authoritative for research atoms; do not bury evidence in prose.
